name: Internshala
notes: Employer banner states posting is free. The employer page links to 'Plans and Pricing', but the plans page returned HTTP 404 and no fee details were read. No language switcher, API, or partner program found. The homepage phrase 'Proud partner of leading government bodies' is a section heading, not a partner program. Operating company named in footer is Scholiverse Educare Private Limited. Employer plans page lists a free plan and paid premium listing prices in INR. Homepage, employer, plans and footer read; no API, developer or partner page linked.

review.note: Employer plans and pricing stated; no headquarters or language options found on the pages read.
